title: Broken checkout in new API deploy
reason: Diagnosis correctly identifies the API component, the AttributeError caused by the deployment, and the trigger as the new version's validation code.
root_cause: The deployment of API version 2.3.2 added order‑validation code that calls .strip() on a field that can be None, causing an AttributeError and returning 500 errors for order POSTs.
truth: api 2.3.2 introduced a regression in the order creation logic: a missing null check on the payment_token field causes an unhandled AttributeError on POST /api/orders, while read endpoints like /api/products still work.
